findings.issue: JWT fallback to Supabase getUser() has no timeout
findings.exploit_chain: Attacker sends batch of expired/garbage tokens → each falls through 1-2 JWT secret attempts → Supabase getUser() hangs for 30s → connection pool exhaustion → denial of service for legitimate users
findings.impact: DoS via connection pool exhaustion by sending many invalid JWTs
findings.fix: Add AbortSignal.timeout(5000) to supabase.auth.getUser(token) call in the fallback path

findings.issue: Users router has no requireOrgAccess — any authenticated user can access any user's data
findings.exploit_chain: Authenticated user from Org A calls GET /api/v1/users/:id with Org B user's UUID → no org membership check → returns Org B user's email, role, permissions → cross-tenant user enumeration
findings.impact: Cross-tenant user enumeration and PII exposure
findings.fix: Add requireOrgAccess middleware or per-route org membership checks on users router

findings.issue: Admin search has no org scope — returns results across all organizations
findings.exploit_chain: Admin user with access to Org A calls GET /api/v1/search?q=... → supabase query returns results from all orgs → admin sees Org B data they shouldn't
findings.fix: Add organization_id filter to search queries or requireOrgAccess middleware

findings.issue: Profiles router has no org check — any authenticated user can access any profile
findings.exploit_chain: User A enumerates profile UUIDs → GET /api/v1/profiles/:id for User B → returns full_name, email, phone, avatar_url → PII harvesting across orgs
findings.impact: Cross-tenant PII harvesting (names, emails, phone numbers)
findings.fix: Add requireOrgAccess or limit profile reads to user's own org members

findings.data_path: IP → rateLimitAuth counter → 10 requests/15min per IP
findings.issue: Auth rate limit is per-IP only — attacker can rotate IPs via botnet to brute-force passwords
findings.exploit_chain: Attacker controls 1000 IP botnet → each IP gets 10 attempts per 15min → 10,000 password attempts per 15min → successful brute-force of weak passwords
findings.fix: Add per-email rate limiting (max 5 attempts per email per 15min) in addition to per-IP limit

findings.issue: Session cookie may lack proper SameSite=Strict and Secure flags — CSRF token not confirmed
findings.exploit_chain: Attacker hosts malicious site → user clicks link while logged into portal → browser sends mct_session cookie via POST to attacker-controlled endpoint → session hijack via CSRF if SameSite not set
findings.fix: Explicitly set cookie with httpOnly=true, secure=true, sameSite='strict', path='/'

findings.scenario: Partial write failure in bulk operations
findings.issue: Bulk operation in 1 file(s) uses catch+console.error instead of checking per-item .ok status
findings.behavior: User selects 10 documents → clicks 'Delete' → 7 succeed, 3 fail → catch block logs error → UI shows success toast → user thinks all 10 deleted → data inconsistency
findings.impact: Users unaware of partial failures — data inconsistency silently introduced
findings.fix: Return {ok, error} per item from API and surface partial failures in UI with detailed error list

findings.issue: Tables defined in migrations but never queried in API code: IF, if
findings.remediation: Either add API endpoints for these tables or remove them from migrations
findings.impact: Dead schema increases migration complexity and storage cost

findings.issue: Bulk invite operations not wrapped in a Supabase RPC transaction — partial invite failure leaves inconsistent state
findings.remediation: Move bulk invite logic into a Supabase RPC function with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK
findings.impact: If one invite fails mid-batch, earlier invites are already committed — org membership state is inconsistent

findings.issue: PR alignment comments use sample_data.json (static demo data) instead of real analysis output
findings.remediation: Point to real engine output files: engine/outputs/global_findings.json
findings.impact: PR comments show fake P0/P1 counts — no actual gating

findings.issue: Prod terraform apply gated by prod-approval environment but no required E2E/test workflow_call dependency before apply
findings.remediation: Add needs: [validate, e2e] to terraform-apply-prod job
findings.impact: Terraform changes can be approved and applied even if tests or E2E tests are failing

findings.issue: Worker has no Prometheus metrics endpoint — task count, queue depth, error rates invisible
findings.remediation: Add prom-client metrics endpoint or expose BullMQ queue stats via health server
findings.impact: Queue backlogs and error spikes in worker are invisible until users report issues

findings.issue: PII fields (email, phone, full_name) stored in profiles table without encryption at rest
findings.remediation: Enable Transparent Column Encryption (TCE) or Supabase Vault for PII columns
findings.impact: Database compromise exposes user names, emails, and phone numbers in plaintext

findings.issue: Domain routing middleware runs on every request — adds JWT decode overhead even on static assets
findings.remediation: Use Next.js matcher config to exclude _next/static, favicon.ico from middleware execution (already done in config)
findings.impact: Minimal — already mitigated by matcher config

findings.issue: Circuit breaker state changes are not exported as Prometheus metrics
findings.remediation: Add prom-client Gauge to track circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=open, 2=half-open)
findings.impact: Ops cannot see which external services are being circuit-broken
